A Creative Hub for AKAR CO.

AKAR CO.

Designing a website that reflects AKAR CO.'s unique brand identity, prioritizes visual storytelling, and empowers them to easily update content as their creative collective grows.

Client

AKAR CO.

Timeline

6 weeks

Year

2024

Platform

Framer

Overview

AKAR CO. is a Singapore-based creative collective specializing in talent development (AKAR) and creative content production (AKAR Studios). AKAR, meaning 'roots' in Malay, focuses on nurturing emerging artists through personalized talent management and captivating storytelling marketing. They needed a website that would reflect their unique brand identity and showcase their diverse creative works.

Project Goals

  • Create a website that reflects AKAR CO.'s unique brand identity
  • Prioritize visual storytelling to engage visitors
  • Implement a user-friendly CMS for easy content management
  • Showcase their diverse creative works and talent roster
  • Attract a wider audience and increase website traffic

Target Users

Emerging artists seeking talent development, potential collaborators looking for creative content production, and businesses interested in AKAR Studios' creative services.

The Challenge

Brand Identity Representation

AKAR CO. needed a website that would authentically reflect their unique brand identity as a creative collective focused on nurturing emerging talent and storytelling.

Visual Storytelling Requirements

The website needed to prioritize visual storytelling to engage visitors and showcase their creative works in an immersive way.

Content Management Needs

As their talent roster and business grows, they needed an easy way to update artist profiles, news, and events without technical assistance.

Visual storytelling increases engagement by 300% compared to text-only content

Research shows that creative agencies with immersive, interactive websites attract more qualified leads and better represent their capabilities.

Design Process

We started with an in-depth discovery call to understand AKAR CO.'s vision for their website and align it with their business goals. We conducted a brand immersion session to capture their brand personality and created detailed user personas and user journey maps to ensure the website caters to the needs of both artists and potential collaborators.

Our comprehensive design process from discovery to launch, ensuring brand alignment and user-focused design.

Key Design Decisions

Immersive Web Design

Incorporated interactive elements like hover effects and parallax scrolling, particularly on the 'About Us' page, to create an engaging brand narrative experience.

Visual Storytelling Focus

Prioritized visual storytelling throughout the site to showcase AKAR CO.'s creative works and talent roster in a compelling way.

User-Friendly CMS

Implemented a content management system that empowers AKAR CO. to effortlessly manage artist profiles, news, and events as their roster expands.

Brand Identity Integration

Ensured seamless branding across all channels, reflecting AKAR CO.'s unique identity as a creative collective focused on nurturing emerging talent.

The Solution

Core Principles

  1. Visual storytelling should be the primary method of engaging visitors and showcasing creative capabilities
  2. Every design decision should reflect AKAR CO.'s unique brand identity as a creative collective
  3. The website should grow with the business, making it easy to add new talent and showcase expanding creative works

Interactive homepage design with immersive visual storytelling and brand narrative

About Us page featuring parallax scrolling and hover effects for engaging user experience

Key Features

Interactive Design Elements

Incorporated hover effects and parallax scrolling to create an immersive brand narrative experience that engages visitors.

Visual Storytelling Platform

Designed the website to prioritize visual storytelling, showcasing AKAR CO.'s diverse creative works and talent roster effectively.

User-Friendly CMS

Implemented a content management system that empowers AKAR CO. to effortlessly manage artist profiles, news, and events as their roster expands.

SEO Optimization

Applied basic SEO best practices to optimize search engine visibility and improve online discoverability for potential collaborators.

Impact & Results

Significant

Rise in Website Traffic

The new website attracted a wider audience, leading to a significant rise in website traffic and improved online visibility.

Central

Platform for Creative Works

AKAR CO. now has a central platform to showcase their diverse creative works and talent roster effectively.

Efficient

Content Management

The user-friendly CMS empowers them to efficiently manage website content as their business flourishes and roster expands.

Key Takeaways

Visual Storytelling Drives Engagement

Incorporating interactive elements and immersive design creates a more engaging brand narrative that resonates with creative audiences.

Brand Immersion Leads to Better Results

Conducting thorough brand research and creating detailed user personas ensures the website authentically represents the client's unique identity.

CMS Empowers Business Growth

A user-friendly content management system allows creative collectives to easily showcase expanding talent rosters and creative works.

Process-Driven Approach Ensures Success

Following a structured process from discovery to launch, including wireframes, prototypes, and SEO optimization, leads to successful outcomes.
